content: Karapau Ar Kǝra Ndǝr PathlaƏnga Malatǝsal
Yesu nar nyi najaka karapǝ anǝ zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar aga ja highiɓǝri nda aga nda dumwa ǝnga ndǝr anǝ Hyal parangǝ, a sara nda hǝɗa mai.
Ji na, “Wu vanyi mǝlmǝ vanyi ndǝr pathla aˈyi kǝra gǝra hivǝr Hyal ǝnga kǝra gǝra tal nji.
Wu mǝlmǝ kǝ vanyi malatǝsal aˈyi kǝra a vǝr shili parangǝ ǝgya ndǝr pathla ja vǝr kǝdi nyi ju na, ‘Dlǝwari ɗa ga nǝ ɗa sǝra tsaˈa aga nǝ ɗa a dumwar dawa ɗa.’
Tanggǝrma ba ji nggǝl, ama wu yukuɗǝ kǝ ji na wu ɗǝfuwa ja, ‘Alaga kǝ aˈyi yu hivǝr Hyal mai, nayi tsu wu tal nji mai,
ama ara ǝnggǝra mala kǝ ɓwanǝ ɗa kǝr ǝnga shili ar kǝr ar kǝr, yu nǝ nyi sǝra ju yiwu kau, a sara gangǝkura shili nyi kǝ a nda nǝ ɗa hǝɗa!’ ”
Kǝ Thlagǝ na, “Nggara mǝ ja sǝra ndǝr pathla kǝra gǝra jirkur kǝ na!
Kǝ hyi nggani, Hyal a yiwu nda nǝ nyi sǝra tsaˈa anǝ nji nyi kǝra ji ɗǝmbiya kǝra wu tiwi anǝ nyi vuˈyi ǝnga puci sǝra ndu kǝdi wa? Naja ˈyi wu nda dlǝwari nda ǝnga kusa wa?
Yu na anǝ hyi, ju nda nǝ nda sǝ tsaˈa kǝra ndu kǝdi kukusa. Ama ma Zǝr Ndau wu nda sha shili, wu sa thlǝwa ja njir mbǝrsa wu duniya kǝ ya?”
Karapau Ar Kǝra Ndǝr FarisiƏnga Ndǝr Tsǝm Budau
Yesu na najaka karapǝ anǝ njira hǝri Kǝrnda abǝr nji tsapǝu nga nda, nda dzǝgwa diɗana alenyi nji.
Ji na, “Nji sayi mǝliya nji mǝthlǝ kǝra maˈyi a gwu ki Hyal aga nda gwa ndǝr ǝnga Hyal. Pathlǝ wu pama nda ndǝr Farisi, ǝnga vanyi ndǝ kǝ ndǝr tsǝm budau.

“Kǝ ndǝr Farisi hyaˈari ji taˈyau, ji dzǝguya ndǝr anǝ Hyal ja vǝr na, ‘Hyal, a usa ngǝ ri yau ara nayau aˈyi ǝnggǝr alenyi nji mai, njir hǝl, njir dlǝrbau, nji sǝsu. Nayi tsu aˈyi ǝnggǝr ndǝr dlǝwu budǝ kǝ mai.
Yu hǝ zǝmǝtsini mǝthlǝ wu sugu, yu hǝbiya pathlǝu wu sǝ kumo patǝ kǝra yi uya.’
“Ama kǝ ndǝr dlǝwu budǝ kǝ taˈyu naɗǝu, naja aˈyi ɗa tsaˈa ja hyaˈana liya ja a dǝmǝlmǝ mai, kǝ ji cabiya tǝtǝwakur nyi, ja vǝr na, ‘Hyal, tǝhuɗǝ ǝgya yau, nayi ndǝr bikau!’ ”

Yesu na, “Yi wu na nǝ hyi, ndǝr tsǝm budau, ji sha a ndu ki nyi gǝra bikau wu mwar Hyal, aˈyi ǝnggǝr ndǝr Farisi mai. Arya kalar ndǝra hǝri kǝrnyi, nju nda hǝya nyi. Ama ndǝra hǝya kǝrnyi, nju nda hyaˈana nyi.”
Yesu Fǝr Nyi Barka Anǝ Wazha
Alenyi nji shili ǝnga wazha aga Yesu a fǝnggǝr nda barka. Ənggǝra zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar lari abangau, ba ndǝ tsa ar kǝra nda.
Ama kǝ Yesu ngga wazha, ji na, “Piyara mau wazha yiɗǝɗǝ nda shili ǝgya yau. Hya sara ka nda mai. Arya, tǝlkur Hyal anǝ nji ǝnggǝr nanda nga nyi.
Ənga jiri yu na anǝ hyi, kǝmir ndǝra gǝra dlǝwuri tǝlkur Hyal ǝnggǝra zǝr kushu wu dlǝwu, naji wu sǝn vwagwa mai.”
Ndǝ Bǝrba Kǝra Wu Tǝɗǝmwa
Vanyi ndǝr tǝɗǝmwa nǝ Yahudiya yiwa Yesu ji na, “Malǝmǝ, ndǝ mǝnahǝu, mi nga ya mǝl ya uya pi gǝra kuɗa?”
Kǝ Yesu na anǝ nyi, “Ara mi gu ngga ɗa ndǝ mǝnaha? Ndǝ mǝnahǝ aˈyi mai kǝl Hyal wacu.
A sǝni gau sǝra dlaɗau cabiya, ‘Ga sara tsa ndǝ mai. Ga sara mǝl sǝsukur mai. Ga sara hǝl mai. Ga sara thla fati ar kǝra ndǝ mai. Ga sara dlǝrbǝ ndǝ mai. Ga gǝnggǝr nyi sǝli anǝ dǝngǝ ǝnga mǝngau.’ ”
Kǝ zǝr baduwari ta na anǝ nyi, “A ɓǝlar yi sǝˈyar kǝ patǝ tsu yi zǝr kushu. Mi ngǝ sǝra hya?”

Yesu nar nyi, “Sǝ zǝm wacu ngǝ hyau anǝ ngau, ma gu yiwu ga ɗa ndǝ tsapǝu, ga maˈyi ga nda ɗǝlna patǝr sǝra ara gau, ba ga tǝkǝna gǝnna nyi anǝ nji ɗaɗali, gu uya akkǝri a dǝmǝlmau. Ba ga dzǝgwa shili aga ga sa nu ɗa.”
Ənggǝra ji nggari abangau kǝ zǝr baduwari kǝ ndalǝr bama, kǝ ji maˈyi ǝnga huɗǝ ndzǝndzau, ara naja ndǝr bǝrba gagaɗau.
Ənggǝra Yesu lari ɗǝfuwa ja a ndzǝ ri, kǝ ji na, “Wu nda ɗa dzadzau gagaɗau anǝ njir gǝnna nda gwu tǝlkur Hyal!
Arya wu nda ɗa ɓatsǝ anǝ dlǝgwam ja tǝrabiya wu liya libǝra, a ndiya ndǝr gǝnna ja vu tǝlkur Hyal.”
Njira nggari ndǝr kǝ ndǝ yiwa nyi, ndǝ na, “Ma abangǝ nga nyi, wa ngu sǝn uya mbǝɗa?”
Yesu na, “Sǝra gǝra sǝn ɗa ngau, anǝ ndau, ama anǝ Hyal ɓatsu.”
Kǝ Biturusu shaɗǝwa, ji na, “Kǝja ˈya piyari sǝ patǝ ˈyi nu ngau.”
Yesu shaɗǝwa nyi, ji na, “Wu sǝn yau abangǝ, yu nar hyi jirkura nyi tsu, kalar ndǝra piyari ki ǝnga zamǝˈyar, ǝnga kwamǝˈyar, ǝnga tada ǝnga ama ba ǝkkǝˈyi wazha ǝnga fa arya tǝlkur Hyal
ju nda uya gangǝu a adabanga sǝˈyar kǝ ji piyari ǝnggau wu duniya kau, wu duniya kǝra wu shili kǝ tsu pi kǝra kuɗau.”
Yesu Ɓǝra Ndǝr Ar KǝraCuli Tǝ Kǝra Ji Wu Nda Tau
Kǝ Yesu hǝri zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar kumo apǝ mǝthlǝ a ndar batiti, ji na anǝ nda, “Kǝja, mǝn wu mai a vu Urshalima, vi kǝra sǝra nabiˈyar tsǝfǝri ar kǝra Zǝr Ndau wu nda nyabiya dzau.
Nju nda lǝri nyi anǝ njira aˈyi njir Yahudiya mai, aga nda diɗana nyi, nda nǝ nyi ɓwaɓwatǝu, nda dzǝgwa tǝfǝri nyi tuli.
Ndu nda dǝgǝ nyi ǝnga wuɗa, nda tsǝya nyi, ama pida makǝrkura nyi ba ja hyaˈari sara vir tau.”
Ama zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar nggabiya sǝ kǝ Yesu na kǝ mai. Ɗǝɗǝwa ngǝ sǝra ndǝr kǝ cabiya anǝ nda, ca ngǝ ɗa nandǝ sǝni nggabiya mai.
Yesu Mbǝɗana Ndǝr KǝdiyauKǝra Lǝfau
Ənggǝra Yesu dla lǝhǝu wu dzǝri Yariko, kǝ ja ndǝ lǝfau a vǝr nggya ar thlǝr pa lagu, ja kǝdiyau.
Ənggǝra ji nggari nji gangǝu a vǝr tǝrabiya, kǝ ji yiwa sau ji na, “Mi nga vǝr ɗa?”
Kǝ ndǝ na anǝ nyi, abǝr, “Yesu ndǝr Nazǝratu nga vǝr tǝrabiya.”
Kǝ ji hyaˈana ɗahǝu ji na, “Yesu! Zǝr Dawuda!
Tǝhuɗǝ ǝgya yau!”
Njira a dumwa ndǝ kughi anǝ nyi aga ja haɗiya miya ja. Ama kǝ ji ɓǝra hyaˈana ɗahǝu gagaɗau ja vǝr na, “Na gǝ, Zǝr Dawuda, tǝhuɗǝ ǝgya yau!”
Kǝ Yesu taˈyau, ji na, “Shila mau ǝnga ja ǝnggau.” Ənggǝra ji shili lǝhǝu, Yesu yiwa nyi,
“Mi nga gu yiwu ya mǝliya nga?” Kǝ lǝfǝ kǝ shaɗǝwa, ji na, “Thlagǝu, ya yiwu ya lari sau.”
Yesu na anǝ nyi, “Lari sau! Mbǝrsa ngau a pahǝnari liya gau.”
Aga zǝmǝ kǝ liya ja lari sau, kǝ ji nu Yesu, ja vǝr dlǝvǝ Hyal. Ənggǝra nji lari sǝ kǝ ɗa kau, kǝ ndǝ patǝ fal Hyal.

footnotes.text: Najakǝ ngǝ thlǝmǝ kǝra nji nǝ nyi anǝ Yesu ndǝr mbǝɗa nji. Aˈyi cabiya abǝr Dawuda ngǝ tada yaya nyi mai, ama sara wu culi nyi ǝnggǝra nabi ɗǝɗǝmˈyar nana. Tsamiya Luk 1:32; 4:31.
